Name: Partial fraction decomposition (PFD(a, b))
Basic relationship:
1. Perform polynomial division if the degree of the numerator is higher than that of the denominator.
2. Factorize (N(x)) into irreducible factors.
3. Set up a partial fraction decomposition with unknown coefficients.
4. Put everything over a common denominator and identify the coefficients.
5. Verify (check the result).
